meta.name: get-available-resources
meta.description: Detect host inventory and effective CPU, memory, disk, scheduler, container, and accelerator limits when a user asks for resource-aware planning or before a clearly resource-sensitive local workload. Produces a redacted JSON snapshot and conservative planning helpers without stress tests or assuming visible host hardware is usable.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 获取主机可用资源快照，辅助运行前判断
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你常跑吃资源的大任务，想知道本机是否扛得住。
copy.tagline_en: Get a snapshot of your machine's available resources before launching a task.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run resource-heavy tasks and want to know whether your machine can handle them.

howto.what: 在计算密集型任务开始前,Claude 会运行检测脚本,查 CPU 核数、GPU(NVIDIA/AMD/Apple Silicon)、内存与磁盘,在工作目录生成 .claude_resources.json,并附并行处理、内存与 GPU 加速建议。
howto.when: 当你在数据分析、模型训练、大文件处理等计算密集型任务开始时,或要求做资源感知规划时,它会先接管。

say.text: 先检测一下这台机器的资源,再决定怎么跑

say.text: 我要训练神经网络,先看看有没有可用的 GPU
say.note: 报告可用的 GPU 后端

say.text: 分析这个 50GB 数据集前,先查内存和磁盘
say.note: 据此判断是否该用 Dask/Zarr

howto.what_en: Before compute-intensive tasks, Claude runs a detection script for CPU cores, GPUs (NVIDIA/AMD/Apple Silicon), memory and disk, writes .claude_resources.json in the working directory, and adds parallel, memory and GPU suggestions.
howto.when_en: At the start of compute-intensive work such as data analysis, model training or large file processing, or when resource-aware planning is requested.

say_en.text: Check this machine's resources first, then decide how to run
say_en.note: Writes a resource snapshot plus strategy advice

say_en.text: I want to train a neural net — see if a GPU is available
Before analyzing this 50GB dataset, check memory and disk
